workload: Public synthetic K_1 curves, polynomial-basis subspace, target [17]G; exact ANFs exported with the repository builder
semantics: One degree-bounded Macaulay pass: each nonzero input generator f multiplied by every squarefree monomial t of degree <=D-degree(f). Products cancel duplicate masks. Not iterative MutantXL closure, full F4, a solving-degree measurement, or an attack.
controls: independent in-memory echelon basis on small controls
exact rank and mutual row-space containment
zero-byte and bounded pivot cache equality
first and minimum-weight legal pivot choices
order: degree descending, mask ascending within degree; reverse-variable grevlex optional diagnostic
trace_policy: Record legal same-leading-column pivot choices, feature and decision time, cache/disk counters. No learned-policy efficacy claim; frozen train/calibration/heldout training remains unimplemented.
timing: Shared host, isolation tier 0; diagnostic elapsed time only. No speedup or fastest-engine claim; no external matched comparator available.
